syllabus_topics: Design criteria and the fouling factor
The log mean temperature difference method
Methodology to calculate a heat exchanger
Dimensionless parameters in boiling and condensation
Laminar film condensation on a vertical plate
Thermoelectric power generation and refrigeration systems
teaching_methods: Individual or group work, problem-solving, and lab reports
assessment_rules: To pass the course, the overall grade must be greater than or equal to 5/10, AND the grade in the midterm exam must be greater than or equal to 3/10, AND the grade in the exam must be greater than or equal to 3/10. For the extraordinary examination, parts not passed (midterm exam if below 5/10, exam if below 5/10) must be retaken. The same passing criteria apply. In the second grade calculation for resits, the midterm exam counts for 71.4% and the exam for 28.6%, if other components are not considered.
bibliography: F. P. Incropera, D. P. De Witt, T. L. Bergman, and A. S. Lavine, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, 6th edition, John Wiley & Sons, United States of America, 2007.
Y. A. Çengel and M. A. Boles, Thermodynamics: An Engineering Approach, 5th edition, McGraw-Hill, 2006.
